name: steam-headless
extra_parameters:
--hostname=steam-headless --security-opt writable-cgroups=true
        --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --security-opt systempaths=unconfined --cgroupns private
        --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --cap-add SYS_PTRACE --cap-add NET_ADMIN --cap-add DAC_READ_SEARCH
        --cap-add SYS_NICE --device-cgroup-rule c 13:* rwm --stop-signal SIGRTMIN+3
        --stop-timeout 30 --pids-limit 8192 --shm-size 2g -t
        --tmpfs /run --tmpfs /run/lock --tmpfs /tmp --tmpfs /dev/input:rw,dev,mode=0755
description: Steam Headless is a containerised gaming desktop with Steam and Sunshine pre-installed. See the Steam Headless documentation for setup, GPU configuration and troubleshooting: https://steamheadless.com/docs/installation/host-preparation/Unraid WARNING: Host networking supports one Steam Headless container only. To run more than one, use macvlan networking and configure unique hostname values and appdata paths for every container.

paths.name: User Profile
paths.description: Persistent Steam profile, Proton prefixes, desktop settings and browser state. Keep on a direct cache-pool or disk path, never a /mnt/user FUSE share, and private to this container.

paths.name: Steam Headless State
paths.description: Persistent settings, TLS certificates and Sunshine pairing keys. Use the direct cache-pool default, not a /mnt/user FUSE share. Set this alongside User Profile when changing the appdata location.

paths.name: System Journal
paths.description: Persistent system and service logs. Use the direct cache-pool default, not a /mnt/user FUSE share, or SHUI may be unable to read logs. Set this alongside User Profile when changing the appdata location.

paths.name: Game Library
paths.description: Steam library path. Use a direct disk or Unassigned Devices path, not a /mnt/user share.

paths.name: Local Time
paths.description: Provides the host timezone to the container.

paths.name: Input Discovery
paths.description: Read-only virtual-input sysfs required by the container's virtual-input service.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Numeric host user ID that should own the persistent profile and games files.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Numeric host group ID that should own the persistent profile and games files.

variables.name: Session Mode
variables.description: Initial frontend mode. Use 'desktop' for KDE Plasma or 'gaming' for nested Gamescope and Steam Gamepad UI.

variables.name: Desktop Steam Autostart
variables.description: When set to 'true' (default), the background systemd service starts Steam automatically with the desktop and restarts it after it closes. Set to 'false' to disable the autostart service while leaving Steam installed for manual launch.

variables.name: Compositor Render Device
variables.description: [OPTIONAL] DRM render device used by the desktop compositor. Leave blank to select the first available render node.

variables.name: Encoder Render Device
variables.description: [OPTIONAL] DRM render device used by SHUI and Sunshine for hardware video encoding. Leave blank to use the compositor render device.

variables.name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
variables.description: NVIDIA runtime selection. Defaults to all NVIDIA GPUs; set a specific NVIDIA device ID when the host has multiple NVIDIA GPUs and only one should be passed into the container.

variables.name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
variables.description: NVIDIA runtime capabilities. All provides graphics, compute and NVENC video libraries.

devices.name: GPU Render Node
devices.description: GPU rendering and hardware encoding device. Run 'for node in /sys/class/drm/renderD*; do pci=$(basename $(readlink -f $node/device)); echo /dev/dri/$(basename $node) - $(lspci -s $pci); done' to list render nodes with their GPU vendor and model.

devices.name: FUSE Filesystem
devices.description: Required by Flatpak and AppImage sandboxing.

devices.name: Virtual Input
devices.description: Required for virtual keyboard, mouse and controller input.

devices.name: Virtual HID
devices.description: Required for virtual HID controller emulation.
